title.en: The Company That Erased Its Own Name

caption.en: One observer, ten scenes, one company.
caption.ko: 한 사람이 멀리서 본 열 장면.

en: A company gave up its own name.

moral.en: The name changed. The habit didn't.

cta.en: Another company, watched from a distance.

subtitle.en: A company gave up its own name.

narration.en: A company gave up its name. The room stayed quiet that day.
narration.ko: 회사 하나가 자기 이름을 버렸다. 그날 회의실은 조용했다.

narration.en: Advertisers closed their wallets. The hallway emptied out.
narration.ko: 광고주들이 지갑을 닫았다. 복도가 비어 갔다.

narration.en: Headlines said people were leaving. The app stayed in their hands.
narration.ko: 사람들이 떠난다는 기사가 쏟아졌다. 손안의 앱은 그대로였다.

subtitle.en: It bought what it couldn't build.

narration.en: It bought a photo app. Then a messenger. Paid in cash.
narration.ko: 사진 앱을 샀다. 메시지 앱도 샀다. 현금으로.

subtitle.en: A new name, a new world.

narration.en: It changed its name. Drew a new world. Nobody walked in.
narration.ko: 이름을 바꾸고 새 세상을 그렸다. 아무도 그 문을 열지 않았다.

narration.en: The next year it cut into itself. Empty chairs stacked in the hall.
narration.ko: 그다음 해 회사가 살을 깎았다. 빈 의자가 복도에 쌓였다.

narration.en: The ones who stayed built something quiet. They fixed the machine behind the screen.
